changelog.title: Insight Phase Expanded
changelog.description: CLH-005 through CLH-011 now require analysis questions after completing objectives. Each lab tests comprehension, not just command execution.

changelog.title: Hidden Intel Rewards
changelog.description: Labs reward exploration - find hidden files (.dead_drop, .shadow_network, .exfil_protocol) to answer insight questions.

changelog.title: Per-Lab Accent Colors
changelog.description: Each lab has unique styling: cyan (007), green (008), pink (009), purple (010), orange (011).

changelog.title: Smart Hints
changelog.description: After 3 wrong answers, contextual hints guide students without giving away the answer.
